label: A distance-based correlation model
subgoals: Write the correlation as a function of distance only
Evaluate the exponential kernel at the given distance and correlation length
Require the resulting covariance matrix to be positive semidefinite

label: Correlation of two gate delays
subgoals: Share the global variance fully between the two gates
Weight the spatial variance by the distance correlation
Divide the covariance by the total variance

label: Skew between two sinks
subgoals: Cancel the global term in a difference of delays
Weight the spatial variance by one minus the correlation
Take the square root of the summed variances for the skew sigma
